claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature.catalog_ref.languages_override
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Catalog-ref summons can encode initiative, command, and dismissal behavior, but cannot encode that the summoned creature understands the summoner's languages without duplicating the whole stat block inline.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental ... understands your languages, obeys your commands..."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature.item_rooted_nearest_space_placement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface only has a coarse range header for spawned creatures. This item needs deterministic placement in the nearest unoccupied space to the censer, not merely a generic self-ranged summon.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible..."
